# Column-convex king-lattice animals (polyplets) that are also directed in
# Bacher's 5-step forward cone {W, NW, N, NE, E} from the leftmost-bottommost
# cell (A047781's directedness condition), counted by cell count n. NOT YET
# SUBMITTED to OEIS -- staged pending jasonp's decision to submit.
# a(1)-a(700). No OEIS match on the 9-term prefix or the full series
# (experiments/oeis_lookup.py, 2026-08-05).
# Method: cpp/middle_kingdom_tm.cpp mode ccdir5, a column-bottom-profile
# transfer matrix (docs/middle-kingdom-plan.md Phase 3). Proposition 1
# (results/middle-kingdom-phase3.md) proves the class is exactly the
# column-convex animals whose bottom profile is valley-unimodal (nonincreasing
# then nondecreasing); validated against an independent brute-force
# Redelmeier DFS to n=14 (make gate-king-grid) and against
# build/convex_area_tm's independent row TM via the hv mode overlap
# (make gate-middle-kingdom). Rational GF, DOUBLE pole:
# F(x) = x(1-5x+9x^2-6x^3+2x^4) / [(1-x)(1-4x+2x^2)^2],

# a(n) ~ C n (2+sqrt(2))^n, C=0.10370... (measured stable to n=700). The
# quadratic 1-4x+2x^2 is A007052's denominator: this class is two
# A007052-like directed runs glued at the profile's valley. Full derivation:
# results/middle-kingdom-phase3.md.
# - Jason H Parker, Aug 05 2026
